about_the_game:
Well, well… you have been in the archipelago for a long time now, so you may decide to find your way out…
You just need to find vehicles and the parts to repair them! But don’t feel confident just because you are familiar with the setting…
You only have one opportunity to make it out alive and the enemies are stronger than ever…[/b]

Includes:
  • - Permadeath !
  • - Major randomization.
  • - Health and damage of enemy increased, every enemy is a threat!
  • - Fewer resources

content_descriptors.notes: Players can blow up zombies, set them on fire, chop them to pieces...
